Lets at most so many items through in a period, like 3 copies of a trader a day, counted per value of a field or all together; the rest leave from limited. It remembers across runs and restarts.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `logic.throttle` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main`, `limited` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| At most (`limit`) | whole number | yes |  | How many items may go on in a period. |
| In (`per`) | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `1h` | no | `24h` | The period they count over, back from each item: 24h is any 24 hours. |
| Count per (`field`) | text | no |  | Counts each value of this field on its own, e.g. trader.address for each trader. Empty: all items together. Names a field of the items it receives; saving checks the items have it. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on as they are.
